title: Handley Page Halifax LL362
memorial_details: Plain, rectangular, brass plaque mounted on a light-wood (possibly beech) backboard. Dedication is in black, upper and lower-case letters.
inscription: ROYAL AIR FORCE/ THIS PLAQUE IS PLACE IN MEMORY AND GRATITUDE TO/ (name)/ AGED 24 YEARS/ (name)/ AGED 24 YEARS/ WHO SACRIFICED THEIR LIVES AVOIDING HOUSES/ IN SWANLAND IN A HALIFAX BOMBER/ WHICH CRASHED ON 2ND SEPTEMBER 1944./ "WE WILL REMEMBER THEM"
original_title: Flight Lieutenant L Cumberworth and Flying Officer J Easdale - Handley Page Halifax LL362
community_connection: IN SWANLAND IN A HALIFAX BOMBER
